input: Negotiate the renewal terms on my office lease

gold.taskTitle: Negotiate and Renew My Office Lease Terms
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to negotiate the renewal terms on their existing office lease.

questions.title: When does your current office lease expire?
questions.description: Understand the timeline and urgency of the negotiation.

questions.title: What is the single biggest term you want to change?
questions.description: Identify the user's primary negotiation priority, such as rent reduction, lease length, or build-out allowance.

questions.title: Have you already been in contact with your landlord?
questions.description: Determine the current state of communication and whether negotiations have already begun.

questions.title: Do you have a real estate broker or attorney representing you?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user is negotiating alone or has professional representation.

questions.title: What is your current monthly rent and target rent?
questions.description: Establish the financial baseline and the user's goal rent figure.

questions.title: How long a renewal term are you hoping to secure?
questions.description: Understand the desired lease duration the user wants to negotiate for.

questions.title: Do you have competing spaces or relocation as a fallback option?
questions.description: Assess the user's negotiating leverage and whether they have alternatives to renewing in place.
